title: Climate Intelligence: Harnessing AI for a Greener Future
description: AI is used in climate work for emissions tracking, climate modelling, renewable planning, forecasting, and measurement that has to survive scrutiny.
short_description: A clear guide to emissions tracking, climate modelling, renewable planning, and the difference between useful measurement and green gloss.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in climate and environmental strategy for conservation teams, climate readers, policy staff, and sustainability-minded operators.
